title: Refiller
description: Transfer matching items to nearby containers and sort inventories with multiple modes.
body:
Inspired by Terraria, Refiller brings smart inventory management to Minecraft with QuickStack and advanced sorting. Goal? Making inventory organization effortless instead of tedious.

### QuickStack - One Key, Everything Sorted
Press **K** to instantly transfer matching items from your inventory to nearby containers. No more manually sorting items into chests!

- Automatically finds chests, barrels, and shulker boxes within range (configurable: 6 blocks horizontal, 3 vertical)
- Only transfers to containers already containing that item type - no unwanted mixing
- **Server-Safe**: Works on vanilla servers without requiring server-side installation!
- Protects your hotbar from accidental deposits by default.

### Inventory Sorting - Multiple Sorting Modes
Organize inventories with dedicated GUI buttons, double-click, or middle-click empty slots.

**Sort Modes:**
- **Name**: Alphabetical sorting for quick item lookup
- **Category**: Groups similar items (tools, blocks, food, etc.)

Right-click sort buttons to switch modes instantly. Smart auto-compacting ensures optimal space usage.

### Fully Configurable
- Adjust QuickStack range and behavior
- Customize sorting preferences
- Toggle sounds, notifications, and visual feedback
- In-game GUI via Mod Menu + Cloth Config (both optional)

### Usage

**QuickStack:** Stand near storage → Press **K** → Done!
**Sorting:** Click sort button (⇅N or ⇅C) → Right-click to change mode
